n, t = map(int, input().split())
# pyramid[i][j] for i from 0 to n-1, j from 0 to i
pyramid = [[0.0] * (i + 1) for i in range(n)]

pyramid[0][0] = t  # pour all champagne at once

full_count = 0

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i + 1):
        if pyramid[i][j] >= 1.0:
            full_count += 1
            overflow = pyramid[i][j] - 1.0
            if i + 1 < n:
                pyramid[i + 1][j] += overflow / 2.0
                pyramid[i + 1][j + 1] += overflow / 2.0

print(full_count)
